scope: Conditional 3+1 flat Minkowski reconstruction with fixed labelled anchors and known intensity; no intrinsic anchor selection
jitter: independent integers -1,0,1 divided by 64, all coordinates of nodes 1..6; node 0 fixed; no outcome-based replacement
input_mask: 10 anchor-anchor and 10 anchor-target intervals; p-q withheld from reconstruction and its bound
primary_arm: joint Poisson atoms; noisy anchor Gram matrix and noisy target distances
diagnostic_arms: exact anchor Gram with noisy target distances
independent Poisson marginals (deliberately wrong joint law)
structural_guard: positive all 20 input counts, exactly one negative and three positive eigenvalues, numerical eigenvalue ratio <1e12, positive finite reconstructed tau squared
success: structural and count guards plus relative proper-time error <=0.10
accuracy_gate: At primary density each of the 20 geometries has one-sided Clopper-Pearson lower success bound >=0.90; Bonferroni family alpha=0.05 over 20 geometries
uncertainty: Per observation, 20 Bonferroni-adjusted central Garwood intervals with joint nominal coverage >=0.95, followed by an analytic whitened inverse-perturbation bound; floating-point evaluation, not formally verified numerics
uncertainty_gate: At primary density each geometry has one-sided Bonferroni CP lower bound >=0.90 for obtaining a <=10% relative-error certificate

marginal_count_check.tests: two-sided exact Poisson tail checks for aggregate counts, all 20 geometries x 4 densities x 21 intervals
